title: S&P 500 Erases Its Decline on Hormuz Deal Hopes: Markets Wrap
summary: Hopes for an agreement to revive the Strait of Hormuz spurred a rebound in stocks and bonds from session lows, tempering worries about the impacts of still-elevated oil prices on inflation.

title: Repsol Says 90% of Its Crude Supply Risks Breaching New EU Rules
summary: Repsol SA anticipates about 90% of its crude oil supplies falling short of new European Union methane requirements that are due to take effect in January, the latest in a series of warnings from the industry that the rules could threaten the region’s energy supplies.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 24
summary: Oil swung amid renewed optimism for diplomatic progress toward reopening the critical Strait of Hormuz, reviving hopes of a near-term increase in flows.

title: Iran Flights to UAE Halted as US Sanctions Bite Connectivity
summary: Iranian flights to the United Arab Emirates were canceled as US sanctions start biting into Tehran’s already limited connectivity with other countries.

title: Global Bond Rout Brings Highest US 30-Year Yield Since 2004
summary: Yields on the US’s longest-dated bonds climbed to the highest level in more than two decades, the latest milestone in a global selloff driven by inflation fears and concern about government debt burdens. Bloomberg Intelligence's Ira Jersey joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: New York Sues Polymarket US as ‘Illegal Gambling Business’
summary: New York sued Polymarket US for allegedly running an illegal gambling business, escalating the legal fight against prediction markets in the state.

title: TJ Maxx Is a Force in Luxury Retail
summary: TJ Maxx has become a force in luxury retail, taking advantage of department stores canceling orders and brands clearing end of season lines. But whilst it’s good for shoppers as the average price of luxury goods increases, the strategy has risks for the store and the high-end labels, explains Bloomberg Opinion columnist Andrea Felsted.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stocks Drop as Oil Rally Fuels Treasury Volatility
summary:
A renewed episode of bond volatility left traders unwilling to make riskier bets, with stocks falling on worries that elevated oil prices will fuel inflation and force the Federal Reserve to lift rates.
Keith Lerner, CIO at Truist, discusses the path of the S&P amid mounting market pressures. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Petrobras Executive Says Braskem to Reach Deal With Creditors
summary: A Petrobras SA executive who sits on Braskem SA’s board says he expects the Brazilian petrochemicals producer will be able to reach a deal with creditors to restructure some $11 billion of debt and avoid a bankruptcy filing.

title: Trump-Backed Export Ban Could Initially Lower Diesel Prices
summary: A potential US ban on diesel exports would slash domestic prices for the fuel at the outset, but the effect is likely to be short-lived, according to executives, traders and analysts.

title: European Gas Advances as US-Iran Tensions Cloud Supply Outlook
summary: European natural gas rose after Iran threatened to expand the war in the Middle East, dimming hopes that energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz will normalize anytime soon.

title: Top Intelligence Panel Democrat Seeks Briefing on F-35 Parts
summary: The top Democrat on the Senate intelligence committee said he wants the Trump administration to brief his members on how sensitive F-35 stealth warplane parts ended up in China’s possession.

title: Intervention Risk Re-Emerges as Yen Extends Slide Toward 160
summary: Yen intervention risk is back in focus with Japan returning from holiday as a two-week long slide in the currency puts it back within reach of the closely watched level of 160 per dollar.

title: Proxy Adviser Glass Lewis Merges With Clarity AI: ESG Investing
summary: Glass Lewis & Co. is merging with European-focused ESG data and analytics firm Clarity AI, as the proxy adviser expands its footprint in a market where investor demand for managing climate and sustainability risks are on the rise.

title: European Stocks Drop as Bonds Sell Off Globally and Oil Climbs
summary: European stocks retreated for a second day as oil prices spiked and global bonds sold off, with the average yield rising to levels not seen for almost two decades.

title: Westwood CEO Says Texas ETF Listing Aligns With Business
summary: Brian Casey, chief executive officer of Dallas-based Westwood Holdings Group Inc., says the decision to list a new exchange-traded fund on the Texas Stock Exchange makes sense because the power-generation ETF is focused on Texas. He speaks with Bloomberg's Julie Fine about the ETF, the future of the TXSE and how artificial-intelligence regulation affects technology stocks. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: India Lets Portfolio Managers Invest Abroad, Short Stocks
summary: India’s market regulator will allow its $463-billion portfolio management industry to invest in overseas securities and undertake short selling in equity options for the first time as part of a massive overhaul of rules.
